theme: A student at a desk by a window at night, desk lamp on (shot as: a hand writing with a dip pen at a dark desk, an inkwell and a blurred clock behind; the line sits on the dark inkwell from the first frame)

philosophy.idea: Claim the hour you have: lay hold of today's task instead of waiting on tomorrow
philosophy.source: Seneca, Moral Letters to Lucilius, Letter 1 'On Saving Time' (Gummere: 'Lay hold of today's task, and you will not need to depend so much upon tomorrow's. While we are postponing, life speeds by.'), checked 2026-11-26 at standardebooks.org (Gummere translation)
philosophy.use: interpretation in our own words, not a quote

post.caption: Me sinto atrasado na vida, como se todo mundo já estivesse lá na frente. Na primeira carta a Lucílio, Sêneca pede pra segurar a tarefa de hoje, porque enquanto a gente adia, a vida passa. O que cabe na sua próxima hora? ⏳
post.pinned_comment: Completa a frase: hoje eu começo por… 👇
